mapper.select: SELECT m.adcode,m.title,SUM(d.value) AS `value`,d.unit FROM `screen_center_one_data` d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT item_text AS title,item_value AS adcode FROM sys_dict_item WHERE dict_id = (SELECT id FROM sys_dict WHERE dict_code = 'screen_center_region_code') ) m ON d.group_id = m.adcode GROUP BY m.adcode, m.title,d.unit;
